lead.titleZh: 卒中上肢康复：重复经颅磁刺激与直流电刺激、机器人治疗的叠加效应研究
lead.titleEn: Stroke Upper Limb Rehab: Additive Effects of rTMS, tDCS, and Robotic Therapy
lead.paragraphZh: 今日日报共 6 条，覆盖 3 个专业领域。神经康复领域一项 RCT 揭示了重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激联合机器人治疗对慢性缺血性卒中上肢恢复的叠加效应，curatedScore 85 分，最值得关注。此外，行业与执业领域有 4 条消息，显示出监管与政策正在密集变化。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's report includes 6 items across 3 specialties. A highlight is an RCT in neurorehabilitation, scoring 85, on the additive effects of rTMS, tDCS, and robotic therapy for upper extremity recovery post-chronic ischemic stroke. Additionally, there are 4 items concerning industry and practice, indicating active regulatory and policy developments.

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary argues that exercise prescription, a ubiquitous recommendation in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, suffers from limited confidence, consistency, and clarity in its decision-making and communication, emphasizing the need for a shared language and systematic approach.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方是物理治疗的核心技能，但这项综述指出其标准化程度低、沟通不清晰，临床医师应反思自己的处方实践，考虑如何更系统地整合评估、进展和调整。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗最重要的但也是标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章指出，运动处方作为肌肉骨骼物理治疗中的普遍推荐，在决策和沟通方面缺乏信心、一致性和清晰度，强调需要统一语言和系统方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prescription is a core PT skill, yet this review highlights its lack of standardization and clarity in communication. Clinicians should reflect on their own prescription practices and consider how to integrate assessment, progression, and modification more systematically.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，并非系统综述或原始研究，主要基于专家意见和文献解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary article, not a systematic review or original research, primarily based on expert opinion and literature interpretation.

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT明确指出，在慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢恢复中，重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 或经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 并不能为机器人疗法带来额外益处。未来评估联用时，你需要重新审视这两种非侵入性脑刺激的定位和有效性。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激对慢性缺血性卒中后上肢机器人治疗恢复的叠加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、假对照试验（N=36）发现，在慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢机器人治疗中，额外增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）并未带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) does not provide additional benefits to robotic therapy for upper extremity recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. You need to re-evaluate the positioning and efficacy of these non-invasive brain stimulations when considering combination therapies in the future.
items.limitation: 该研究的样本量为36例，虽然是随机双盲对照，但仍属小样本，结果需更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a sample size of 36 patients; despite being a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial, it is still a small sample, and its results require validation by larger-scale studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Supreme Court seeks compliance affidavits on Allied Healthcare Professions Act implementation
items.summary: The Indian Supreme Court has ordered the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to file compliance affidavits on the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021.
items.curatedReason: 印度最高法院要求国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会以及各邦政府提交宣誓书，详细说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施进展。这表明印度政府正在积极推动相关法律的落地，对在印度执业的物理治疗师来说，这意味着执业环境的规范化和标准化，你需要持续关注其进展。
items.titleZh: 印度最高法院要求提交《专职医疗与健康专业法案》实施宣誓书
items.summaryZh: 印度最高法院已下令国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会及各邦政府提交宣誓书，说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Indian Supreme Court has mandated the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to submit affidavits detailing the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021. This indicates that the Indian government is actively promoting the enactment of relevant laws. For physical therapists practicing in India, this signifies the standardization and normalization of the practice environment, and you need to continue to monitor its progress.

items.title: Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC) Procedural Notice Inviting Comment
items.summary: CMS has issued a procedural notice inviting public comment on the Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC), aimed at streamlining Medicare coverage for certain medical devices.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 公告草案事关医疗器械的医保覆盖路径。如果最终通过，它将简化新设备的审批和报销流程，对提供相关创新物理治疗器械的诊所和医院将是利好，但暂时仍处于征求意见阶段。
items.titleZh: CMS 就医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调征求意见
items.summaryZh: 美国医保与医助服务中心（CMS）发布程序性通知，就“医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调”（CMS-3487-NC）征求公众意见，旨在简化部分医疗器械的医保覆盖流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This draft CMS notice concerns the Medicare coverage pathway for medical devices. If finalized, it will streamline approval and reimbursement for new devices, benefiting clinics and hospitals that offer innovative physical therapy devices. However, it is currently in the public comment phase.

items.title: Article - Billing and Coding: MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720)
items.summary: A draft article from CMS discusses billing and coding for MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720), indicating potential policy updates in diagnostic test reimbursement.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 草案文章涉及分子诊断面板的编码和计费，虽然与物理治疗核心业务无直接关系，但它反映了美国医疗保险在精细化诊断测试上的政策动向。作为诊所所有者，你需要关注这类政策变化，了解未来诊断环节可能对你执业环境产生的影响。
items.titleZh: CMS 计费和编码草案：MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了一份关于 MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板（A58720）的计费和编码草案，预示着诊断测试报销政策可能更新。
items.curatedReasonEn: This CMS draft article on coding and billing for molecular syndromic panels is not directly related to core physical therapy services. Still, it reflects policy trends in US Medicare for refined diagnostic testing. As a clinic owner, you need to monitor such policy changes to understand the potential impact of future diagnostic developments on your practice environment.

items.title: Data access and research
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) outlines its policies for data access and research, providing guidelines for accessing information on registered health practitioners.
items.curatedReason: AHPRA 的这份文件解释了其数据获取和研究政策，详细说明了如何获取澳大利亚卫生执业者的注册信息。如果你在澳大利亚从事研究或希望了解当地物理治疗专业人士的公开信息，这份指南至关重要。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚医疗执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 数据获取与研究政策
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚医疗执业者监管机构（AHPRA）阐述了其数据获取和研究政策，为查询注册医疗执业者信息提供了指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This AHPRA document explains its data access and research policies, detailing how to obtain information on registered health practitioners in Australia. If you are conducting research or seeking public information on physical therapy professionals in Australia, this guide is crucial.
